title: Alerts
description: Warnings and notices about the place you are in.
summary: See the warnings and notices posted where you are, such as a flooded car park, a closed gate or a storm on its way, and post your own. An alert goes out over Bluetooth and the local network only. It lasts from a day to a year, and you can withdraw it at any time. A station you own keeps your alerts and gives each one to everybody who arrives, once, so people who come later still hear about it. You are told about a new alert even when the app is closed.
